name: s9-pausing-reserved-capacity
label: EXAMPLE · AI STAND-IN VOICE · NO FACE

lines.say: Pausing your Fabric capacity doesn't save money if you bought a reservation.
A reservation is a prepaid commitment, used hour by hour.
An hour you don't use doesn't carry over. So pausing a reserved capacity just throws those hours away.
Pausing only cuts pay-as-you-go compute, and your storage keeps billing either way.
lines.show: Pausing cuts *pay-as-you-go* compute only. Storage keeps billing.

lines.say: And there's a second surprise. When you pause, any smoothed usage still waiting to be billed is added up and charged straight away.
So before you pause, check two things.
lines.title: CHECKS

lines.say: Is this capacity reserved? And how much smoothed usage is waiting?
The Capacity Metrics app shows it as carry-forward.
Comment PAUSE and I'll send you my capacity cost checklist.
